title: Ice Cream Wafer Coin Collector
description: A raspberry ice cream sandwich that holds your spare change. Sort $1, 50c, 20c and 10c coins into four labelled stacks and lift them out through the front cutouts.
printNote: Each well allows 0.40 mm clearance per side. Print base down at 100% scale. Optional colour changes at 4.4 and 25.6 mm. Coin fit has not been physically tested.

title: Kopitiam Keycap Clicker
description: Press a red-dot pau or a green-striped kopi cup. Both caps fit the same jade saucer keychain, inspired by a Singapore kopitiam breakfast.
printNote: Open the colour 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Under Objects → Red-dot pau, Pau dough uses filament 1 (cream) and Red dot uses filament 2 (red). Match the colours to your AMS Lite spools. Print the saucer and either cap, then fit one full-height MX-style clicky switch and a split ring. Test the fit before use.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm base · approx. 34 mm tall with pau

title: Tutu Keychain
description: A tiny scalloped kueh on its green leaf, now with a reinforced eyelet to carry a little Singapore everywhere.
printNote: Flat-back print · green to white at 3 mm. Add a metal keyring; strength and fit untested.

title: CHOPE Desk Marker
description: The familiar tissue packet, made into a playful desk marker inspired by Singapore’s seat-reserving custom.
printNote: For separate colours, open the 3MF in Bambu Studio and assign filaments to Packet body, CHOPE lettering and Tissue in the Objects list. For the STL parts ZIP, import all three files together as one object with multiple parts to keep them aligned.

title: HDB Block Pencil Pot
description: A miniature neighbourhood for your pencils. Recessed windows and a BLK 01 sign turn a small tower into a familiar home.
printNote: Upright print · 50 × 26 mm opening with a 4 mm floor.

title: Dragon Playground Watch Holder
description: An orange mosaic dragon and colourful climbing hoops frame a medium watch support, sized for 36–46 mm watch cases and 18–24 mm straps. The example watch and soft padding are shown for illustration.
printNote: Proposed fit; test with your watch, especially a fitted metal bracelet. Add 1 mm felt or soft rubber to protect the watch. STL and Blender downloads contain the holder only. Print at 100% scale and check supports under the saddle, snout and hoops.

title: Peranakan Tile Coaster
description: An original floral pattern inspired by the decorative tiles of Singapore’s shophouses, in blue and warm ivory.
printNote: Flat-back print · colour change at 4 mm; heat and stability untested.

title: Hawker Bakes Keycap Clicker
description: A slice missing from the pandan chiffon reveals its green crumb. Swap the cake for a fluted egg tart with a golden custard centre. Both press onto the same kopitiam saucer switch.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm base · 31.2 mm chiffon · 31.6 mm tart across
printNote: The colour 3MF includes a saucer and two caps. Already have the Kopitiam Clicker? Print just a cap and press it onto your existing full-height MX-style switch. Match pandan green, golden brown, custard yellow and jade to your AMS Lite spools. Test the stem fit before use.

title: Kaya Toast & Soft-Boiled Egg Keycap Clicker
description: A kopitiam breakfast in miniature. Press the grill-marked toast with pandan kaya and butter, or swap in a soft-boiled egg with a golden yolk and a splash of soy sauce.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm saucer · 33.8 mm egg dish across
printNote: Open the colour 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Match filaments 1–4 to green, brown, cream and yellow on your AMS Lite. If you already have the saucer and full-height MX-style switch from No. 2 or No. 8, select just the caps to print. For a new set, add a switch and a split ring. Test the stem fit after printing.

title: Iced Gem Biscuit Keycap Clicker
description: A biscuit-tin favourite on a keyring. A twist of pink icing sits on a scalloped golden biscuit, with ten little dimples around the edge.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm saucer · approx. 32 mm biscuit · 21.2 mm cap height
printNote: Open the 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Match filaments 1–3 to jade, biscuit gold and icing pink on your AMS Lite. To change the icing colour, select Piped icing under the biscuit in the Objects list. Already have the clicker saucer and full-height MX-style switch? Print just the cap. For a new set, add a switch and a split ring.

title: Curry Puff Keycap Clicker
description: A golden crescent with curved pastry layers and a row of folded crimps along its toasted edge. Press the puff on its jade saucer for a hawker snack that clicks.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm saucer · 39.7 mm puff width · 23.3 mm cap height
printNote: Open the 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Match filaments 1–3 to jade, pastry gold and toasted brown on your AMS Lite. The crimped seam has its own colour assignment. Tree supports are enabled for the cap. Remove them and clear the stem socket before assembly. If you already have the saucer and full-height MX-style switch, print just the cap. For a new set, add a switch and a split ring.

title: Pineapple Tart Keycap Clicker
description: An open-faced pineapple tart for your keyring. A flower-shaped shortcrust shell holds a mound of amber jam under two crossed strips of pastry.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm saucer · approx. 35 mm tart width · 16.8 mm cap height
printNote: Open the 3MF as a project in Bambu Studio. Map filaments 1–3 to jade for the saucer, butter gold for the pastry and amber for the jam. If you already have the saucer and full-height MX-style switch, select just the tart cap to print. For a new set, add a switch and a split ring.
